note: FINDING F5 (see README). Nothing in the profiles design reserves `formatToken`, so a profile author may legally declare it as a requirement key — and §4.1 step 2 then instructs the deriver to copy the effective value over the tuple's own metadata member. The design states no rule. The reference fails closed: a tuple whose `formatToken` is not the format token is not an execution-policy tuple, and silently dropping the requirement instead would violate the closed key rule. Proposed disposition in the README; this fixture pins the behavior either way so the choice is visible rather than accidental.
